consequence.statement: The external-secrets.io/v1 version of ExternalSecret becomes available to use. The evidence shows no failure, rejection or required action caused by adding this version. Other CRD changes in the same release, such as the v1beta1 storage flag and the removed v1alpha1 version and conversion webhook, are separate changes and are not covered here.
